items.title: David Montgomery: Practices again Friday
items.text:
Montgomery (groin) practiced for a second straight day Friday after missing the past month, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Listed as questionable to face Detroit
items.text:
Brown (knee/ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Woody Marks: Back at practice Friday
items.text:

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Listed as questionable for Sunday
items.text:
St. Brown (ribs) was a limited participant in Friday's practice and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Patriots, Tim Twentyman of the Lions' official site reports.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Ruled out for Sunday's game
items.text:

items.title: Omar Cooper: Will practice fully Friday
